title: My best friend
prompt: Write a descriptive paragraph about your best friend.
promptVi: Viết một đoạn văn miêu tả người bạn thân nhất của bạn.
requirements: his or her name, age and where he or she lives
what he or she looks like
what he or she is like (personality)
what you do together and why you like him or her
tips: Câu chủ đề: My best friend is … . Câu kết: I am very happy to have a friend like …
Ngoại hình: She has long black hair and big brown eyes. He is tall and thin.
Tính cách: kind, funny, friendly, helpful, clever, quiet.

title: My bedroom
prompt: Write a descriptive paragraph about your bedroom.
promptVi: Viết một đoạn văn miêu tả phòng ngủ của bạn.
requirements: how big it is and what color the walls are
the furniture and where it is
your favorite thing in the room
what you do there and how you feel in it
tips: There is + danh từ số ít, There are + danh từ số nhiều.
Giới từ chỉ vị trí: in, on, under, next to, between, in front of, behind.
Miêu tả theo thứ tự không gian: from the door → the bed → the window → the desk.

title: A park in my town
prompt: Write a descriptive paragraph about a park or a market in your town.
promptVi: Viết một đoạn văn miêu tả một công viên hoặc một khu chợ ở thị trấn / thành phố của bạn.
requirements: its name and where it is
what you can see there
what people do there
why you like it
tips: Dùng tính từ: big, small, green, quiet, busy, clean, beautiful.
Những gì nhìn / nghe thấy: I can see…, I can hear…
Hoạt động của mọi người: People walk, run, play, sell…

title: A person in my family
prompt: Write a descriptive paragraph about one person in your family.
promptVi: Viết một đoạn văn miêu tả một người trong gia đình bạn.
requirements: who the person is and how old he or she is
his or her job and daily routine
what he or she looks like and is like
what you love about this person
tips: Động từ sau he / she thêm -s / -es: She works…, He watches…
Trạng từ tần suất đứng trước động từ thường: She always gets up early.

title: My last birthday
prompt: Write a narrative paragraph about your last birthday.
promptVi: Viết một đoạn văn kể về sinh nhật gần đây nhất của bạn.
requirements: when it was and where you were
who was with you
what you did, in order
how you felt at the end of the day
tips: Dùng thì quá khứ đơn: was / were, went, had, ate, got.
Từ nối trình tự: first, then, after that, finally.

title: A day at the beach
prompt: Write a narrative paragraph about a day you spent at the beach (or in the countryside).
promptVi: Viết một đoạn văn kể về một ngày bạn đi biển (hoặc về quê).
requirements: when you went and who you went with
how you got there
what you did in the morning and in the afternoon
how the day ended
tips: Động từ bất quy tắc: go → went, swim → swam, eat → ate, take → took.
Thời gian: in the morning, at noon, in the afternoon, in the evening.

title: My first day at a new school
prompt: Write a narrative paragraph about your first day at a new school or class.
promptVi: Viết một đoạn văn kể về ngày đầu tiên của bạn ở trường hoặc lớp mới.
requirements: how you felt in the morning
what happened when you arrived
who you met
how you felt at the end of the day
tips: Tính từ cảm xúc: nervous, shy, happy, excited, tired.
Kể theo trình tự thời gian và kết thúc bằng cảm xúc của bạn.

title: A happy Sunday with my family
prompt: Write a narrative paragraph about a happy Sunday you spent with your family.
promptVi: Viết một đoạn văn kể về một ngày Chủ nhật vui vẻ bên gia đình.
requirements: what you did in the morning
where you went or what you ate
something funny or nice that happened
why it was a happy day
tips: Quá khứ đơn với động từ có quy tắc: cook → cooked, visit → visited, play → played.
Nêu lý do: It was a happy day because…

title: Online or classroom learning
prompt: Do you think studying online is better than studying in a classroom? Why?
promptVi: Bạn nghĩ học trực tuyến có tốt hơn học trên lớp không? Vì sao?
requirements: state your opinion clearly in the first sentence
give two reasons that support your view
add a short example from school or daily life
end with a concluding sentence that restates your opinion
tips: Mở bài: I think studying in a classroom is better because… / In my opinion, online learning is better…
Lý do + ví dụ: First,… For example,… Second,…
Từ nối: because, so, however, for example, in addition.

title: Phones and young people
prompt: Do you think young people spend too much time on their phones? Why?
promptVi: Bạn nghĩ giới trẻ dành quá nhiều thời gian cho điện thoại không? Vì sao?
requirements: say whether you agree or disagree
explain how phones help or harm study, health or friendships
give one clear example
finish with your overall view
tips: I agree that… / I do not think that…
Useful words: useful, waste time, concentrate, communicate, healthy.
Câu kết: Overall, I believe young people should…

title: City or countryside
prompt: Is living in a big city better than living in the countryside? Why?
promptVi: Sống ở thành phố lớn có tốt hơn sống ở nông thôn không? Vì sao?
requirements: choose city or countryside and state your opinion
give two advantages of your choice
mention one disadvantage honestly
conclude with your preference
tips: So sánh: better than, more… than, less… than.
Ý tưởng: jobs, transport, quiet life, clean air, friends, shops.
However, … để nêu nhược điểm ngắn.

title: School uniforms
prompt: Do you think students should wear school uniforms? Why?
promptVi: Bạn nghĩ học sinh có nên mặc đồng phục không? Vì sao?
requirements: state your opinion about school uniforms
give two reasons (for example cost, equality, comfort or identity)
include a short example
end with a recommendation
tips: I believe students should / should not wear uniforms because…
Useful: equal, expensive, comfortable, look the same, save time.
Kết: For these reasons, I think…

title: Fast food
prompt: Is fast food a bad choice for young people? Why?
promptVi: Đồ ăn nhanh có phải là lựa chọn xấu cho giới trẻ không? Vì sao?
requirements: state your opinion about fast food
explain effects on health, time or money
give one everyday example
conclude with advice for young people
tips: Mở: In my opinion, fast food is…
Từ vựng: unhealthy, convenient, cheap, overweight, cook at home.
Advice: Young people should…

title: Learning English
prompt: Do you think learning English is important for your future? Why?
promptVi: Bạn nghĩ học tiếng Anh có quan trọng cho tương lai của bạn không? Vì sao?
requirements: state how important English is for you
give two reasons linked to study, work or travel
add a personal example
end by saying what you will do to improve
tips: English helps me… / I need English because…
Ví dụ: job interviews, watching films, talking to foreigners.
Kết: That is why I will keep practicing English.

title: My hometown
prompt: Write a descriptive paragraph about your hometown for a friend who has never visited it.
promptVi: Viết một đoạn văn miêu tả quê hương / thành phố của bạn cho một người bạn chưa từng đến đó.
requirements: where it is and how big it is
what it looks like (streets, buildings, nature)
what people usually do there
why a visitor should come
tips: Câu chủ đề: My hometown is…, a … city / town in…
There is / There are + chi tiết cụ thể.
Kết: I hope you will visit someday because…

title: A memorable trip
prompt: Write a narrative paragraph about a trip that you remember well.
promptVi: Viết một đoạn văn kể về một chuyến đi mà bạn còn nhớ rõ.
requirements: when and where you went and who you went with
what you did, in order
one problem or surprise during the trip
how you felt at the end
tips: Quá khứ đơn: went, stayed, visited, bought.
Trình tự: First, Then, After that, Finally.
Cảm xúc: excited, tired, surprised, proud.

title: Cash in the future
prompt: Do you think people will still use cash for buying and selling in the future? Why?
promptVi: Bạn nghĩ trong tương lai mọi người vẫn dùng tiền mặt để mua bán không? Vì sao?
requirements: state your opinion clearly
give at least two reasons with brief explanations
include one concrete example (shops, markets, online shopping, older people, etc.)
conclude by restating your view or making a short prediction
tips: Mở: I think people will / will not still use cash in the future because…
Lý do thường gặp: convenience, security, older people, small markets, internet problems.
Từ nối B1: although, however, for instance, as a result, in conclusion.

title: Online learning vs classrooms
prompt: Do you think online learning will replace traditional classrooms in the future? Why?
promptVi: Bạn nghĩ học trực tuyến sẽ thay thế lớp học truyền thống trong tương lai không? Vì sao?
requirements: state whether online learning will replace classrooms or not
compare advantages and disadvantages briefly
support your view with one example from school or university
finish with a clear conclusion
tips: Useful: replace, face-to-face, interaction, self-discipline, flexible.
Although online courses are convenient, …
In conclusion, I believe…

title: Social media and teenagers
prompt: Is social media more helpful or more harmful for teenagers? Why?
promptVi: Mạng xã hội hữu ích hơn hay có hại hơn đối với thanh thiếu niên? Vì sao?
requirements: choose helpful or harmful as your main view
give two strong reasons
add one real-life style example
acknowledge the other side in one sentence, then restate your opinion
tips: Mở mạnh: In my view, social media is more helpful / harmful for teenagers.
On the one hand… On the other hand… nhưng vẫn nghiêng một phía.
Từ vựng: distract, cyberbullying, stay connected, share information.

title: Practical skills at university
prompt: Should universities focus more on practical skills than on theory? Why?
promptVi: Đại học có nên tập trung vào kỹ năng thực hành nhiều hơn lý thuyết không? Vì sao?
requirements: state your position
explain how practical skills and theory help students differently
give one example related to jobs or projects
end with a recommendation for universities
tips: I believe universities should…
Useful: prepare for jobs, problem-solving, internship, balance.
Therefore, universities ought to…

title: Working from home
prompt: Do you think working from home is better than working in an office? Why?
promptVi: Bạn nghĩ làm việc tại nhà có tốt hơn làm việc tại văn phòng không? Vì sao?
requirements: state your preference
give two reasons about time, focus, teamwork or well-being
mention one drawback of your preferred option
conclude with your overall opinion
tips: Working from home allows people to…
However, office work makes it easier to…
Overall, I prefer…

title: Electric vehicles
prompt: Are electric vehicles a good solution to pollution in cities? Why?
promptVi: Xe điện có phải là giải pháp tốt cho ô nhiễm ở thành phố không? Vì sao?
requirements: state whether electric vehicles are a good solution
explain effects on air quality, noise or cost
give one example or comparison with petrol cars
conclude with a balanced but clear final view
tips: Electric vehicles can reduce…
Although charging stations are still limited, …
In short, I think they are / are not enough on their own.

title: AI and jobs
prompt: Do you think artificial intelligence (AI) will replace many jobs in the next twenty years? Why?
promptVi: Bạn nghĩ trí tuệ nhân tạo (AI) sẽ thay thế nhiều công việc trong hai mươi năm tới không? Vì sao?
requirements: state your prediction clearly
give two reasons with short explanations
include one job or industry as an example
end with advice for young people
tips: I think AI will / will not replace many jobs because…
Useful: automate, create new jobs, soft skills, lifelong learning.
Young people should…

title: A difficult decision
prompt: Write a narrative paragraph about a time when you had to make a difficult decision.
promptVi: Viết một đoạn văn kể về một lần bạn phải đưa ra quyết định khó khăn.
requirements: describe the situation and why the decision was difficult
explain the choices you had
say what you decided and what happened next
end with what you learned
tips: I could not decide whether to … or …
If I had…, I would have… (điều kiện loại 3 khi suy ngẫm).
That experience taught me that…
